career_spells.role: Member for Everton, including parliamentary-secretary appointments
career_spells.evidence_note: Queensland Parliament records election for Everton on 21 March 2009 and departure after defeat on 23 March 2012. It records service as Parliamentary Secretary for Health from 9 April 2009 to 3 March 2011 and for the Treasurer and Minister for State Development from 3 March 2011 to 23 March 2012.

The Parliamentary Handbook records senior-associate service at Maurice Blackburn from 2012 to 2016. Watt's biography describes employment-law practice for workers and unions and class actions for farmers, shareholders and consumers. Exact commencement, Senate-transition, hours and leave evidence are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but year-only boundaries and missing full-time evidence prevent counting.
